<thought>Based on the formula C5H8O2, DBE = 2 and one carbonyl, a plausible structure is ethyl acrylate (CH2=CH‑COO‑CH2CH3). The molecule can be viewed as two connected fragments: the acrylate moiety and the ethyl group. Their SMILES strings are “C=CC(=O)O” and “CC”.</thought>
<final_answer>['C=CC(=O)O', 'CC']</final_answer>
